items.title: Dave S. Oxley Sr. Interview, 1965-01-06
items.q: Cafe Society, with Edmund Hall's band

ctx.x: I think Ida was a little older than Bessie.

I thought maybe she might be too. Yeah. She was a little older than Bessie. I didn't know. Did Ida ever use a microphone? I know Bessie ordinarily didn't bother with the microphone, had such a big voice. I never heard Ida Cox, but about, oh I did hear in New York at a club too, Cafe Society, with Edmund Hall's band. Yeah. She was there one winter, just part of the winter, maybe a month or so. She된 stuff
I didn't remember. I got caught out tonight.
